purpose: Merge every validated persistable SteamDB lookup result into the persistent history cache even when the current lookup scope is still partial, migrate legacy schema 1 entries to canonical writer schema 2, and repair metadata without inventing historical values. Unresolved keys remain outside the cache and continue through GitHub-owned retry state.

merge_rules.confirmed_min: persist only a positive exact KZT historical minimum from the validated lookup ledger
merge_rules.unavailable_exact_history: persist status unavailable_exact_history only when stage 16 marks the result persistable and source-reached evidence is present
merge_rules.unresolved: never persist or invent a negative cache entry; leave the key in GitHub-owned retry state
merge_rules.existing_and_new_key: validated stage-16 result replaces the previous entry for that exact key
merge_rules.partial_registry: merge every validated registry entry even when validated_resolution_count is smaller than expected_true_miss_count
merge_rules.entry_count: must equal actual len(entries) after merge

pass_requires: stage 16 validation status is partial or complete
cache is written at most once if changed
all validated stage-16 resolutions are represented in schema-2 cache
unresolved keys are not written as guessed, blocked or negative-cache results
legacy entries are migrated without changing their historical values
